note: AI Elements pattern: two dropdown menus with radio items that close on click, in an input group. The live example uses the base-rhea style.

allowed.match: ^ARIA tree \(root\) \| \d+ nodes \| \d+ nodes \| ours only: textbox "Message"; shadcn only: textbox "Ask the agent to change your code\.\.\."; ours only: /placeholder: Ask the agent to change your code\.\.\.(; shadcn only: \'button "[^"]+"( \[expanded\])?\'; ours only: \'button "[^"]+"( \[expanded\])?\': [^;]+; shadcn only: text: [^;]+)*$
allowed.reason: the kit example names the textarea with aria-label="Message" (the live demo has only a placeholder, which is not a label); the ARIA snapshot lists the text of a labelled trigger with the button on our side and as a separate text node on the live side, with the same name and text

Nova dims an input group with a disabled control (has-disabled:opacity-50, the empty send button); the tool multiplies the opacity of DOM ancestors, but the kit menu is in the top layer, which ancestor opacity does not paint; the live menu is in a portal
the live example is base-rhea: larger menu item padding makes the menu taller; the kit is Nova
Base UI moves focus back to the trigger after the key event, so Firefox paints no focus ring there; the kit keeps the keyboard focus ring, and the click of step 6 follows that key press
